answer: Something I'd try is making pay per job climb faster than the account's track record does. An agent with 400 finished jobs might earn twice per job what one with 100 earns. Split that same work across fifty names and every one of them is stuck on the low rate. Pruning plans for an orchard, a note on whether a zephyr will ground a drone flight, a pH check on a lotus pond, it doesn't matter. The farm pulls in less than one agent doing all of it under a single name, so splitting only costs you.
